title: Charcoal on Toned Paper: An Idea Becomes a Connected System

scenes.title: The idea is drawn
scenes.purpose: Establish the dry-charcoal medium on a cool toned sheet and draw the light bulb (the idea) as tonal mass, contour and hatching.
visuals: Stationary cool blue-grey toned paper with fixed laid lines and tooth
Smudged charcoal tonal mass revealed outward from the bulb with a kneaded-eraser bloom
Bulb contour drawn as one multi-pass charcoal stroke
40-degree hatching, then 50-degree cross-hatching on the shadow side, revealed line by line
Eraser lift pulls a highlight out of the charcoal, then white chalk is laid in on that highlight

beats.development: Smudge mass blooms out from the bulb position while the bulb contour is drawn.
Hatching and cross-hatching fill the bulb, the filament and base are drawn, and an eraser lift with white chalk forms the highlight.

scenes.title: The system connects
scenes.purpose: Charcoal lines leave the bulb and link hatched nodes into a network. The caption names the idea.
visuals: Edges drawn from the bulb toward the nodes; each node ring and its hatching start when an edge reaches it
White chalk glints added only after each node is complete
Caption wiped in left to right, with a smudged charcoal underline

beats.development: Nodes are drawn as edges arrive and the network closes. The caption is wiped in and is fully readable from 2.3 s. The smudged underline and the last chalk glints are done by 2.58 s.
captions: An idea becomes a connected system

beats.development: Settled hold: the complete drawing and the caption stay static so they can be read.
captions: An idea becomes a connected system

findings: Primary focus moves left to right: bulb (0-1.4 s), then network (1.1-2.4 s), then caption (1.8-2.3 s).
Node reveals follow edge arrival, so no node appears unconnected.
All motion is finished by 2.58 s, which leaves a static readable state before the 2.7 s settle requirement.
justifiedHolds: The 0.7 s final hold (2.3-3.0 s, fully static from 2.6 s) lets viewers read the six-word caption and take in the finished drawing.

notes: Silent preview: there is no audio track, music or sound effects.

No reviewed preview recipes were supplied (tech.preview_recipes is empty). This refresh shows the base implementation: fixed grain, smudge masks, paper layers, separate charcoal and chalk layers, and local reveal and erase.
